1029:     -------
1030:     comparison_scores : np.ndarray, shape=(n,), dtype=float
1031:         Comparison scores, in [0.0, 1.0], or -1 if the comparison is out of
1032:         gamut.
1033:     """
1034:     validate(reference_labels, estimated_labels)
1035:     ref_roots, ref_semitones = encode_many(reference_labels, False)[:2]
1036:     est_roots = encode_many(estimated_labels, False)[0]
1037:     comparison_scores = (ref_roots == est_roots).astype(np.float64)
1038: 
1039:     # Ignore 'X' chords
1040:     comparison_scores[np.any(ref_semitones < 0, axis=1)] = -1.0
1041:     return comparison_scores
1042: 
1043: 
1044: def mirex(reference_labels, estimated_labels):
1045:     """Compare chords along MIREX rules.
1046: 
1047:     Examples
1048:     --------
1049:     >>> (ref_intervals,
1050:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
1051:     >>> (est_intervals,
1052:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
1053:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
1054:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
1055:     ...     ref_intervals.max(), mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD,
1056:     ...     mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD)
1057:     >>> (intervals,
1058:     ...  ref_labels,
1059:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
1060:     ...      ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels)
1061:     >>> durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
1062:     >>> comparisons = mir_eval.chord.mirex(ref_labels, est_labels)
1063:     >>> score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)
1064: 
1065:     Parameters
1066:     ----------
1067:     reference_labels : list, len=n
1068:         Reference chord labels to score against.
1069:     estimated_labels : list, len=n
1070:         Estimated chord labels to score against.
1071: 
1072:     Returns
1073:     -------
1074:     comparison_scores : np.ndarray, shape=(n,), dtype=float
1075:         Comparison scores, in [0.0, 1.0]
1076: 
1077:     """
1078:     validate(reference_labels, estimated_labels)
1079:     # TODO(?): Should this be an argument?
1080:     min_intersection = 3
1081:     ref_data = encode_many(reference_labels, False)
1082:     ref_chroma = rotate_bitmaps_to_roots(ref_data[1], ref_data[0])
1083:     est_data = encode_many(estimated_labels, False)
1084:     est_chroma = rotate_bitmaps_to_roots(est_data[1], est_data[0])
1085: 
1086:     eq_chroma = (ref_chroma * est_chroma).sum(axis=-1)
1087: 
1088:     # Chroma matching for set bits
1089:     comparison_scores = (eq_chroma >= min_intersection).astype(np.float64)
1090: 
1091:     # No-chord matching; match -1 roots, SKIP_CHORDS dropped next
1092:     no_root = np.logical_and(ref_data[0] == -1, est_data[0] == -1)
1093:     comparison_scores[no_root] = 1.0
1094: 
1095:     # Skip chords where the number of active semitones `n` is
1096:     #   0 < n < `min_intersection`.
1097:     ref_semitone_count = (ref_data[1] > 0).sum(axis=1)
1098:     skip_idx = np.logical_and(
1099:         ref_semitone_count > 0, ref_semitone_count < min_intersection
1100:     )
1101:     # Also ignore 'X' chords.
1102:     np.logical_or(skip_idx, np.any(ref_data[1] < 0, axis=1), skip_idx)
1103:     comparison_scores[skip_idx] = -1.0
1104:     return comparison_scores
1105: 
1106: 
1107: def majmin(reference_labels, estimated_labels):
1108:     """Compare chords along major-minor rules. Chords with qualities outside
1109:     Major/minor/no-chord are ignored.
1110: 
1111:     Examples
1112:     --------
1113:     >>> (ref_intervals,
1114:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
1115:     >>> (est_intervals,
1116:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
1117:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
1118:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
1119:     ...     ref_intervals.max(), mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD,
1120:     ...     mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD)
1121:     >>> (intervals,
1122:     ...  ref_labels,
1123:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
1124:     ...      ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels)
1125:     >>> durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
1126:     >>> comparisons = mir_eval.chord.majmin(ref_labels, est_labels)
1127:     >>> score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)
1128: 
1129:     Parameters
1130:     ----------
1131:     reference_labels : list, len=n
1132:         Reference chord labels to score against.
1133:     estimated_labels : list, len=n
1134:         Estimated chord labels to score against.
1135: 
1136:     Returns
1137:     -------
1138:     comparison_scores : np.ndarray, shape=(n,), dtype=float
1139:         Comparison scores, in [0.0, 1.0], or -1 if the comparison is out of
1140:         gamut.
1141: 
1142:     """
1143:     validate(reference_labels, estimated_labels)
1144:     maj_semitones = np.array(QUALITIES["maj"][:8])
1145:     min_semitones = np.array(QUALITIES["min"][:8])
1146: 
1147:     ref_roots, ref_semitones, _ = encode_many(reference_labels, False)
1148:     est_roots, est_semitones, _ = encode_many(estimated_labels, False)
1149: 
1150:     eq_root = ref_roots == est_roots
1151:     eq_quality = np.all(np.equal(ref_semitones[:, :8], est_semitones[:, :8]), axis=1)
1152:     comparison_scores = (eq_root * eq_quality).astype(np.float64)
1153: 
1154:     # Test for Major / Minor / No-chord
1155:     is_maj = np.all(np.equal(ref_semitones[:, :8], maj_semitones), axis=1)
1156:     is_min = np.all(np.equal(ref_semitones[:, :8], min_semitones), axis=1)
1157:     is_none = np.logical_and(ref_roots < 0, np.all(ref_semitones == 0, axis=1))
1158: 
1159:     # Only keep majors, minors, and Nones (NOR)
1160:     comparison_scores[(is_maj + is_min + is_none) == 0] = -1
1161: 
1162:     # Disable chords that disrupt this quality (apparently)
1163:     # ref_voicing = np.all(np.equal(ref_qualities[:, :8],
1164:     #                               ref_notes[:, :8]), axis=1)
1165:     # comparison_scores[ref_voicing == 0] = -1
1166:     # est_voicing = np.all(np.equal(est_qualities[:, :8],
1167:     #                               est_notes[:, :8]), axis=1)
1168:     # comparison_scores[est_voicing == 0] = -1
1169:     return comparison_scores
1170: 
1171: 
1172: def majmin_inv(reference_labels, estimated_labels):
1173:     """Compare chords along major-minor rules, with inversions. Chords with
1174:     qualities outside Major/minor/no-chord are ignored, and the bass note must
1175:     exist in the triad (bass in [1, 3, 5]).
1176: 
1177:     Examples
1178:     --------
1179:     >>> (ref_intervals,
1180:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
1181:     >>> (est_intervals,
1182:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
1183:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
1184:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
